features.name: aimbot
features.title: Aimbot
features.about: Soft aim with five aim types, FOV circle, sticky target, team / dead / wall checks.

features.name: silent_aim
features.title: Silent Aim
features.about: Silent aim with hit chance and FOV. Needs an executor with hookmetamethod.

features.name: triggerbot
features.title: Triggerbot
features.about: Shoots what is under the cursor, with delay, max distance, team check and a status line.

features.name: rage
features.title: Rage
features.about: Automatic combat: targeting, burst fire, positioning, spinbot, abilities and the RAGE status text.

features.name: cursor
features.title: Cursor
features.about: Custom crosshair with styles, rainbow, animations and an 'aiming at' label.

features.name: esp
features.title: ESP
features.about: Player ESP: 3D box, skeleton, health bar, names, chams, tracers, plus fullbright, time of day and FOV.

features.name: visuals_shader
features.title: Visuals
features.about: Shader look: vivid colours, future lighting, reflections, clear air, pretty water, lock time.

features.name: fly
features.title: Fly
features.about: Fly with the root's velocity (no body movers), vertical speed and smoothing.

features.name: noclip
features.title: Noclip
features.about: Walk through walls.

features.name: speed_jump
features.title: Speed & Jump
features.about: Speed, jump power, infinite jump and anti stun. WalkSpeed / JumpPower are not touched: the CFrame mover does the work.

features.name: cframe_speed
features.title: CFrame Movement
features.about: CFrame Speed, CFrame Fly and Dash: move the character by changing its CFrame.

features.name: anti_fling
features.title: Anti Fling
features.about: Stops other players' bodies from flinging you and cancels sudden launches.

features.name: anti_ragdoll
features.title: Anti Ragdoll
features.about: Refuses the ragdoll / hit-stun state (made for The Strongest Battlegrounds).

features.name: anti_void
features.title: Anti Void
features.about: Puts you back on the last solid ground when you fall below the map.

features.name: desync
features.title: Desync & Anti Aim
features.about: Other players see you elsewhere (stay, behind, left, right, above, lag, orbit); anti aim jitter/spin; a ghost copy shows where they see you.

features.name: teleport_spectate
features.title: Teleport & Spectate
features.about: Teleport to a player, spectate, click teleport (hold a key and click).

features.name: follow
features.title: Follow Player
features.about: Follow a player at a distance, with a gliding automatic distance.

features.name: orbit
features.title: Orbit Player
features.about: Circle around a player (circle, bob or figure eight) with lock-on.

features.name: no_animations
features.title: No Animations
features.about: Stops the animations of your own character (stop all, attacks only, freeze pose).

features.name: inventory_inspector
features.title: Inventory Inspector
features.about: Shows what a player holds and carries.

features.name: anti_afk
features.title: Utility
features.about: Anti AFK and rejoin the current server.

features.name: whitelist_blacklist
features.title: Whitelist & Blacklist
features.about: Friends are skipped by every targeting feature, blacklisted players are targeted first. Auto-whitelists Roblox friends.

features.name: fling
features.title: Fling
features.about: Fling one player or everyone (loop), Void Spam with targets and delays, and a LOADING status text.

features.name: punch_fling
features.title: Punch Fling
features.about: A real punch animation plus one short fling per punch (TSB's Normal Punch inside TSB).

features.name: avatar_copy
features.title: Avatar
features.about: Become a copy of another player or of any Roblox user (by name or id). Only on your screen.

features.name: spin
features.title: Spin
features.about: Spin your character around any axis at any speed (others see it).

features.name: headsit
features.title: Headsit
features.about: Sit on somebody's head with the real sit animation (others see it).

features.name: fe_animations
features.title: FE Animations
features.about: Emotes, your own animation ids, sit anywhere, lay down: animations others can see.

features.name: superman_fly
features.title: Superman Fly
features.about: Fly like Superman (R6 and R15, the arm pose is measured) with a hover pose; others see it.

features.name: custom_skybox
features.title: Custom Skybox
features.about: A drawn sky (sunset, neon night, aurora ...) or your own image as the sky. Only on your screen.

features.name: clean_visuals
features.title: Clean Visuals
features.about: Removes screen effects, fog and particles; can switch off camera shake.

features.name: freecam
features.title: Freecam
features.about: Detach the camera from your character (WASD, E/Q up/down, Shift faster).

features.name: unlimited_zoom
features.title: Unlimited Zoom
features.about: Removes the camera zoom limit.

features.name: waypoints
features.title: Waypoints
features.about: Save positions with a name and teleport back (saved per game).

features.name: stats_hud
features.title: Stats HUD
features.about: FPS, ping and player count in a corner.

features.name: telekinesis
features.title: Telekinesis
features.about: Pulls loose parts to you and floats them in patterns (Infinity, Ring, Tornado, Galaxy ...). Others see the parts move.

features.name: chat_spy
features.title: Chat Spy
features.about: A draggable window with every chat message your client receives.

aliases.about: CFrame Fly is part of cframe_speed.lua

aliases.about: Anti Aim is part of desync.lua
